prose: Sponsored item: WorkOS pitches auth.md, a machine-readable file that lets AI agents register users for an app without a browser signup flow. Enrolled through the WorkOS dashboard, agents read the file, register, and receive scoped, short-lived credentials.
highlights: WorkOS auth.md: agents self-register without browser signups
basis: Sponsored placement in the Daring Fireball feed; the extracted cache held only the short ad copy.
